verdict.rationale: The client SDK source is public on GitHub (bugsnag-js), and the MCP server is also hosted on GitHub, so some code is readable. Nothing in the evidence states a license, though, and the core BugSnag service is not shown as open. The on-premise edition is self-hosted, but there is no evidence its source is available. Missing for 10: any stated open-source license (e.g. MIT/Apache) for the SDKs, open source for the core platform/backend, and independent confirmation of openness.
